notes.title: Major Update: Vindicta Daemonum
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36039291/fdb29102c7fd6b1fdee6685e22fa70da7283dfed.png[/img]

Update 1.0, a major update is now finally released!

Here's some of the new content for this update:
[list]
[*] Story Mode - 2 Chapters
[*] 4 new heroes
[*] New buildings - Barracks and Spell Tower
[*] You can hire units in Barracks
[*] You can cast 4 spells in a game at your Spell Tower
[/list]

Also contains some more UI changes, gameplay changes and bugfixes.

notes.title: Devblog #1 - Stories Mode
notes.notes:
Hi all, I'd like to post updates of what i'm working on for the game. My plan is to post weekly devblogs of now implemented changes.

I have lots of big plans for different singleplayer modes for this game. For now I'll start simple with "Stories Mode". This mode will feature different short campaign stories with multiple maps. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36039291/0a2c975c87291b1afec1363a80f38ab8abb8d8cf.jpg[/img]

The hero selection screen will also be updated. It's now a "Team creator" screen where players can pick units and spells alongside their heroes. I also added a "Load" and "Save" buttons to quickly load or save your team compositions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36039291/5293370aee65f2ea968a5d9f1b2ec0b8a93582eb.jpg[/img]

These units and spells will aid your heroes in different ways.

UNITS - can be hired from your "Barracks" at your base
SPELLS - can be casted from your "Spell Tower" at your base and can only be used once in a game

notes.title: GtT Update 0.6
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just released a quick update of the game (v.0.6) with some minor changes.

Added this little tip box to help players know about the keyboard shortcut keys. Pressing 1,2,3,4 on your keyboard is a shortcut on using these command buttons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36039291/7fc2893cfbfbbbf7728631ec4e0e904e7fc7e5ad.png[/img]

Made some little optimizations on Online Play lobby screen. You can now do other things while waiting for a match. A sound prompt will alert you if a match is found.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36039291/f8106d5b32f292dfa85589255ee674ed2d18fe71.png[/img]

Also added 16:9 support for the game.

Along with some other little changes and fixes, that's all for now on this update.

I've been working on some things for the next major update, which may take some time to release:
- Singleplayer campaigns
- An interactable overworld
- Some UI redesign
- More content and other customizables (UI skins, etc..)

That will be all for now, See you soon.
SeasonQuest
